record.body:
## Problem

The file store has no cross-record transaction and relies on a file lock. It cannot enforce append-only ops except through a git check.

## Approach

Add a SQLite backend in WAL mode behind the same API. Tables: `ops` (append-only, trigger-protected), `records`, `revisions`. Each write runs in one `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction with the `expected_revision` check. Decide the DB location and whether both backends coexist at settle-phase.

## Exit criteria

- A parallel-writer test shows no lost writes and correct `expected_revision` conflicts. Verified by that test passing.
- Triggers reject an update or delete of an op. Verified by a test.
- `canon validate` passes against a DB store. Verified by running it on a temporary DB store.
